sara_cs: quick heads-up — weekly account health: error-rate focus. saw a +3.7% 5xx jump vs last week, timeouts up 18% during EU morning, and rate-limits increased on a few customers. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/ops/errors-dashboard (link). Top failing endpoints below, cc @ben_ops @mitsu_eng

ben_ops: digging... top errors this week (past 7d):
- /v1/generate — 38% of total 5xx
- /v1/chat/stream — 21% (timeouts)
- /v1/embeddings — 17% (rate-limited, 429)
- /internal/kv/cache — 9% (timeouts)
- /v1/health/check — 5% (5xx, short spikes)

mitsu_eng: looks like the canary from Mon 03:10UTC added a small env change to connection timeouts. rolling back patch showed immediate drop in one test cluster. logs:
```
[2026-03-19T03:12:05Z] ERROR: accept() failed: connection reset by peer
... conn timeout=3s -> 1s
```

raj_support: customer impact: AcmeInc saw 12 timeouts and 4 5xx yesterday between 09:00-10:30 CET, they hit client-side retries and opened a ticket. Renewal risk flagged in Gainsight. They want an RCA.

ben_ops: correlation with bursty embed workloads from partner-integration job. I throttled the batcher for that customer at 11:20 UTC; error rate decreased ~40% in 30m.

sara_cs: action items:
- @mitsu_eng to confirm rollback on prod canaries and PR number
- @ben_ops to add temporary batching cap per-account and escalate quota rule to 5m window
- @raj_support to sync with AcmeInc and share mitigation steps + ETA for RCA
- I'll prepare the weekly note for AMR

mitsu_eng: PR reverted: r/fw-1983 — rollback applied to canaries, monitoring in progress.

chloe_bot: [alert] rate_limit: embeddings-burst — reduced batching for account:partner-42 at 2026-03-19T11:21:34Z

ben_ops: monitoring: error-rate 5xx dropped from 3.7% -> 1.5% in canary cluster; timeouts still ~+6% in EU region, tracking.

sara_cs: thanks. let's reconvene Fri 09:30 PT if stable; if Acme escalates earlier ping me. :thumbsup:
